description: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley values of different morphosyntactic probing methods applied to multilingual BERT models, as indicated by the label on the y-axis. The x-axis contains categories representing different probing methods, which are labeled as L1, L2, L3, R1, R2, R3, R4, and T. The y-axis is labeled "Shapley value" and has a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 20. The bars are color-coded to represent different probing methods: XLM-R, XLM-RL, and chLSTM. The tallest bar corresponds to the T category for the chLSTM method, reaching a value of approximately 80. The shortest bars are observed in the L1, L2, and R4 categories for the XLM-RL method, with values close to 0. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
